SIBLING DEFECT: captures do not run for evidence-only or idempotently-skipped sub-commands, and a completed producer's capture does not always reach a later consumer (REQ-STAMPER-SUBCOMMAND-CAPTURES-NOT-RUN).

The translated plan is under-specified in LAYERS: 22 variables that no capture produces. Each fix reached one layer deeper until the remaining gap was enumerated from the Stamper registries instead of discovered a run at a time.
